argv:
echo "=ID="; id; echo "=PWD="; pwd
echo "=SAAS="; ls -la /home/appontrack/public_html/saas 2>&1 | head -12
echo "=PHP="; command -v php; php -v 2>&1 | head -2
echo "=PHPPATHS="; for p in /opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php /opt/cpanel/ea-php84/root/usr/bin/php /opt/alt/php83/usr/bin/php /opt/alt/php84/usr/bin/php /usr/local/bin/php; do if [ -x "$p" ]; then echo "FOUND $p"; "$p" -v 2>&1 | head -1; fi; done
echo "=EXT="; php -m 2>/dev/null | tr "\n" " "; echo
echo "=COMPOSER="; command -v composer || echo no_composer_bin; if [ -f "$HOME/composer.phar" ]; then echo home_phar; fi; if [ -f /usr/local/bin/composer ]; then echo usr_local_composer; fi; composer --version 2>&1 | head -2
echo "=DB="; command -v mysql || echo no_mysql_cli; mysql --version 2>&1 | head -1; if [ -f "$HOME/.my.cnf" ]; then echo mycnf_present; fi
echo "=DISK="; df -h /home/appontrack 2>&1 | tail -1; quota -s 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=NET="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "packagist:%{http_code} " --max-time 8 https://repo.packagist.org/packages.json; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "github:%{http_code}" --max-time 8 https://api.github.com; echo
echo "=DONE="
